name: 伊拉瑟
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:2367
who: Irase, a night-demon woman of the western mossy-stair city, a calamity-rank legend called the Noon Night who has looked twenty-four or twenty-five since her name was made: about 171 cm. Cold white skin. Indigo hair down past the waist, gathered over her left shoulder (her left, on the viewer's right when she faces us), the last hand-length of it pure white. Silver-white eyes with thin vertical slit pupils that see clearly in the dark. A pair of slender dark horns growing from above the temples, lying close along the sides of the head and curving down and FORWARD so the tips point toward the outer corners of the eyes, NOT rising upward and NOT pointing outward; a SMALL black flame, no bigger than a candle flame, on each tip, giving off no light; NOT large plumes of black smoke. A pale white scar across the back of her neck, always hidden under a band of black velvet. She casts no shadow; other shadows lean toward her feet. A soft-voiced, protective, quietly dangerous air, glamorous and shy of light.
face: FACE, as in the references: a striking, fine-boned woman's face of about twenty-five: long-lashed almond eyes with silver-white irises and thin vertical slit pupils, clearly drawn in every panel and every expression, NOT round pupils; thin indigo brows; a straight small nose; soft lips closed; cold white skin with cool lilac-grey shadows; slender horns lying along the temples and curving forward, a small black flame on each tip.
build: 171 cm, tall and graceful: open, elegant shoulders and neck, an F-cup, a very narrow waist and rounded hips, long legs.
palette: indigo and night black, snow white, silver white, charcoal grey velvet
casual: Her own dress in her city of shade: a long charcoal-grey cloak lined in snow white, its hood held by a broad collar-band of black velvet fastened round the neck, over a close-fitting long-sleeved black dress to the ankles with a modest square neckline and slits at the sides for walking, a thin indigo sash, soft black boots. The indigo hair is drawn over her left shoulder. She stands half-turned from the light, one hand at the velvet collar-band, a soft, guarded look.
private: At home in the cool shade of the old street: the cloak off, a loose long-sleeved indigo house dress to the ankles with a high soft collar, the black velvet band still round her neck, the hair loose over her left shoulder, soft slippers. She holds a small clay pot with a drooping white flower in both hands, a faintly rueful, gentle look.
battle: Bringing night down over a city at noon: the charcoal cloak flung wide behind her like a curtain, its snow-white lining showing, the black velvet collar-band fastened high; over the close black dress a fitted bodice of thin black obsidian scales that drinks the light, slim black obsidian vambraces, black boots. Both arms are spread out to either side, palms down, and ribbons of thick black darkness pour upward from the hem of her cloak and wind close around her body; the black flames on her horn tips burn tall, and her silver-white slit eyes shine. A calm, cold, overwhelming look.
formal: As the mistress of her city: a long gown of deep indigo velvet to the floor with fitted long sleeves and a high collar, the black velvet collar-band over it, a sweeping charcoal mantle lined in snow white fastened at both shoulders with plain black clasps, a fine silver chain across the shoulders, the white-tipped indigo hair laid over her left shoulder. She stands upright and still, hands folded, a gracious, unreadable look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly away from a lamp at the edge of the frame, one hand raised as if asking it to be tilted aside, the silver-white slit eyes glancing back at the viewer, a soft, half-shy look, the lips closed. Warm brass lamplight on one cheek, deep cool indigo dark on the other. Foreground blur: the rim of a brass lamp and a drifting white petal. She wears the charcoal cloak with its snow-white lining and the black velvet collar-band.
battle_old: Bringing night down over a city at noon: the charcoal cloak flung wide behind her like a curtain, its snow-white lining showing, the black velvet collar-band fastened high, the close black dress, black boots. Both arms are spread out to either side, palms down, and ribbons of thick black darkness pour upward from the hem of her cloak and wind close around her body; the black flames on her horn tips burn tall, and her silver-white slit eyes shine. A calm, cold, overwhelming look.
gear: 英雄（约 LVL 165）｜不看（英雄）｜法师式（本事是放夜，不靠甲）｜4档｜苔阶城来的夜魔有名者，英雄定四档；她的本事是把正午拉成夜，不披重甲，照白石的年月魔族那一边加一件吸光的黑曜细鳞紧身胸衣和黑曜护臂，灰黑斗篷、雪白里子、黑丝绒领带照旧。
faces_extra: In every one of the nine panels each pupil is a thin black vertical slit like a cat's, NOT a round dot.

name: 拉多万
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:2128
who: Radovan, a demon of the raven-wood below a fortress ridge, son of a family that fed the ravens, a hero who swore his life to the demon leader he follows, looking about thirty-five: about 186 cm, broad-chested and heavy-armed. Short dark moss-green hair. Silver-white eyes. An old scar from a door nail across his right eyebrow (his right, on the viewer's left when he faces us). A pair of thick horns curving forward, black raven flight feathers bound round their roots, and a small cluster of dark-red flame on each tip, lower than other demons' flames. Pale ash-olive skin. Across his back he carries an iron-banded oak door bar longer than he is tall, eight short horizontal notches cut across it, one for each year. A taciturn, patient, stubborn air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a broad, weathered man's face of about thirty-five: silver-white eyes under heavy dark green brows, an old nail scar across the right brow (his right, on the viewer's left when he faces us); a strong straight nose; a firm closed mouth; pale ash-olive skin with cool grey shadows; thick forward-curving horns with black raven feathers bound at the roots and low dark-red flames on the tips.
build: 186 cm, broad-chested and heavy-armed: thick shoulders and back, big hands, built to lift a gate.
palette: moss green and bone white, raven black, dark ember red, iron-banded oak brown
casual: His sworn warrior's gear: a light harness of pale bone plates strapped over a dark green-black leather coat with fitted sleeves, dark wool trousers and wrapped boots, a raven feather tied at the belt; slung horizontally across his back on two broad straps, the iron-banded oak door bar, longer than he is tall, the eight notches across it facing out. He stands with his thumbs hooked in the straps, a quiet, patient look.
private: Waiting in the raven-wood: the bone harness off, a long-sleeved undyed wool shirt with the cuffs rolled, the dark trousers and boots. He holds the oak door bar upright in front of him with both hands and looks at the eight notches, a still, inward look.
battle: Storming the west gate: full bone armour of heavy pale plates fitted over dark leather, each plate carved with the words of his oath in script that glows a dull ember red, bone pauldrons and greaves, a plate of black obsidian set over the heart, raven feathers bound on the horn roots, the dark-red flames on his horns burning low and steady. He grips the iron-banded oak door bar in both hands like a battering ram, its head forward, the eight notches across it glowing ember red. Leaning in, feet driving, a fixed, unstoppable look.
formal: At the swearing of his oath: a long dark green wool coat that closes down the front with toggles, fitted sleeves, a short mantle of black raven feathers over the shoulders, a plain bone clasp at the throat, the oak door bar slung across his back. He stands straight with his hands at his sides, a grave, settled look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait from slightly below, the silver-white eyes looking straight at the viewer, steady and unafraid, the mouth closed. Cold grey dawn light from one side, a dark red glow from his horn tips on the other. Foreground blur: black raven feathers and the iron-banded end of the oak bar. He wears the bone harness over the dark leather coat.
battle_old: Storming the west gate: full bone armour of heavy pale plates over dark leather, bone pauldrons and greaves, raven feathers on the horn roots, the dark-red flames on his horns burning low and steady. He grips the iron-banded oak door bar in both hands like a battering ram, its head forward, the eight notches across it glowing ember red. Leaning in, feet driving, a fixed, unstoppable look.
gear: 英雄（约 LVL 170）｜贫｜照常｜4档｜喂乌鸦人家的儿子，英雄不看家境定四档；原句的整副骨铠已近这一档，再在骨片上刻他的誓文发暗红的光、心口嵌一块黑曜，背闩、角上的鸦羽和矮火照旧。

name: 沃莎
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:2148
who: Vosha, a fire-horned demon woman of the northern ice plains called Remnant Winter, eighty-four years old but looking about thirty: about 176 cm, tall and strong. Copper-red skin, paler than most of her kin because she grew up on the ice, both cheeks reddened by the wind. Grey-blue hair in one long braid to the waist, its end scorched to burnt gold by her own horn fire. Pomegranate-red eyes. A pair of black horns curving forward; the tip of the left horn is broken off (her left, on the viewer's right when she faces us). An old burn scar on the inside of her left forearm (her left, on the viewer's right). A blunt, practical, warm-handed air; she never feels the cold.
face: FACE, as in the references: a strong, open woman's face of about thirty: pomegranate-red eyes under straight grey-blue brows, a straight nose, a firm closed mouth; light copper-red skin with warm rose shadows and two wind-reddened patches on the cheeks; black forward-curving horns, the left tip broken off (her left, on the viewer's right when she faces us), a small orange flame on the horns.
build: 176 cm, tall and strong-limbed: broad, firm shoulders, strong arms, a lean waist and long legs.
palette: copper red and burnt gold, grey-blue, reindeer-hide brown, frost white, pomegranate red
casual: Her ice-plains clothes: a short reindeer-hide robe with fur at the collar and cuffs worn open at the throat and chest over a close-fitting sleeveless undershirt of soft dark hide, a broad belt of braided hide, fur-trimmed hide trousers and tall soft hide boots, the braid hanging down her back. She stands easy with her arms loose, a frank, plain look.
private: Bedding down beside the others on ground she has warmed: the hide robe off, a loose long-sleeved undyed wool tunic with the left sleeve pushed up to show the burn scar on the inner forearm, the hide trousers and boots, the braid over her shoulder. She holds a folded fur blanket under one arm, a gruff, gentle look.
battle: Sinking fire into the ground: the short reindeer-hide robe belted tight with a broad braided-hide belt over the dark hide undershirt, open at the throat as always; hide bracers and shin guards plated with small black obsidian scales, the fur-trimmed trousers and tall hide boots. She stands braced with her right hand thrust down and open, a dull red heat glowing up her forearm and through the gaps between the obsidian scales, the soles and toes of her boots glowing red-hot; the flames on her horns pressed low and dark red. A hard, patient, burning look, the mouth shut.
formal: At a gathering of the ice-plains clan: a long reindeer-hide coat to the shin, its edges trimmed with white fur and stitched with bands of red and bone-white beads, a red woollen cord wound into the end of the braid, a necklace of small bone discs, tall white-fur-cuffed boots. She stands upright with her hands at her sides, a quiet, proud look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the pomegranate-red eyes looking straight at the viewer, steady and warm, the mouth closed. Pale blue snow light from one side, a low orange glow from beneath on the other as if the ground were warm. Foreground blur: drifting frost and a few sparks. She wears the open reindeer-hide robe with its fur collar.
battle_old: Sinking fire into the ground: the reindeer-hide robe belted tight over the hide undershirt, hide bracers, the fur-trimmed trousers and boots. She stands braced with her right hand thrust down and open toward the ground, a dull red heat glowing up her forearm, the soles and toes of her boots glowing red-hot; the flames on her horns pressed low and dark red. A hard, patient, burning look, the mouth shut.
gear: 英雄（约 LVL 150）｜贫｜朴素（冰原的驯鹿皮，敞着怀不怕冷）｜4档｜北边冰原的炎角有名者，英雄定四档；她照冰原的样子穿驯鹿皮、敞着怀，偏好朴素，只在皮护臂、护胫上缀黑曜鳞片，火从鳞缝里透出来，手里照旧没有兵器。
